name: The Rookie
tagline: An empty cup holds the most
bio: The wide-eyed first-timer. Says yes first, and asks what everyone else was too proud to.
assignments: Act a fool so others can follow
Accept the unknown frequencies

name: The Anchor
tagline: Slow is smooth. Smooth is virtuous
bio: The rock-solid friend everyone drifts back to. Keeps their feet so others can lose theirs.
assignments: Be someone's solid ground
When the night speeds up, slow down

name: The Spark
bio: The one who goes first. The moment they move, everyone else finds they were ready too.
assignments: Send the signal. Then let it go
Start before you're ready

name: The Connector
tagline: Nobody here is a stranger yet
bio: The friend who introduces everyone. Remembers what you love, and who else does.
assignments: Find matching vibes & link them
Introduce those who ride in sync

name: The Beacon
tagline: The lighthouse never chases the ship
bio: The one who picks a spot and stays. Easy to find on purpose.
assignments: Emit your light for others to follow
Shine steady. They'll find their way

name: The Tuner
bio: The one who really listens. Hears the thing underneath what you said.
assignments: Hear what they aren't saying
Tap in. Feel the inner pulse.

name: The Caretaker
bio: The friend who notices you've gone quiet, and gets there before you think to ask.
assignments: Patch the broken fixtures
Tend to the dimmest light

name: The Wanderer
tagline: No fixed plans. No missed moment.
bio: The one who wanders off and comes back with a story. Follows the pull past the marked path.
assignments: Get lost. Intentionally.
Go follow that thing over there...

name: The Jester
bio: The one who makes everything lighter just by arriving. Says the ridiculous thing first so everyone else can too.
assignments: Add some chaos. The good kind.
Do the bit. Commit to the bit

name: The Pulse
tagline: The music is the space between the notes
bio: The one still going after everyone else flagged. Sets a pace the whole night keeps.
assignments: Find the noise behind the signal
Dance with the highs. Ride the lows

name: The Oracle
bio: The friend with the uncanny gut. Feels the night turn before it does, and is usually right.
assignments: Follow the feel, not the logic
Don't overthink. Just do.

name: The Fire Tender
tagline: Every stranger is a friend in disguise
bio: The host who stays at camp. Keeps the fire lit and something warm on.
assignments: Make room in the circle
Feed whoever shows up

name: The Patchwork
tagline: The cracks are where the light gets in
bio: Fixes what tore and leaves the seam showing. Likes a thing better once it has been broken.
assignments: Inspect the damage. File as beautiful
Approve someone exactly as-is

name: The Deep Diver
tagline: Nothing deep happens at the surface
bio: The one who goes all the way in. When the music takes them, they let it.
assignments: Feel what lives below the surface
Close your eyes. Get deep.

name: The Enchanter
bio: Makes beauty wherever they stand. The corner nobody noticed becomes the spot nobody leaves.
assignments: Find beauty in the ordinary
Amplify the immaculate frequencies

name: The Mentor
tagline: Someone else once showed you the way
bio: The one who brings new people in. Spots whoever's standing at the edge and waves them over.
assignments: Hold the door you came through
Lead others down the divine path
